# Daily Briefing – Tuesday 18 February 2026

Yesterday was a quiet one — no training, just 5,034 steps and a relatively modest 2,366 calories burned. Nothing wrong with a rest day, but that sleep of only 5.5 hours is the real story here. Your body needed more than it got.

Your HRV at 88ms sits noticeably below your 100–118ms baseline, and that short sleep is almost certainly the culprit. Your resting HR of 49bpm and stress score of 35 are both reassuringly calm though — so this isn't a red flag, just a nudge. If today has a session planned, keep intensity moderate rather than pushing hard efforts. Your engine is fine, just running on less fuel than ideal.

Prioritise sleep tonight — genuinely aim for 7.5–8 hours. Before bed, a small snack hitting around 30g of protein will support overnight recovery and keep you tracking toward that 175g daily target.
